text:
anna: Profile alert — after the kernel-selector tweak (prefer_fused_gemm=true) we're seeing a perf regression on Mixtral-8x7B jobs. p99 up ~30% and KV cache memory +35%.

jorge: I think qwen-7b traces show similar. Might be fallback to generic matmul for non-standard head/kv dims. Can you paste the profiler dump?

anna: Paste from profiler:
```
[profile] model=mixtral-8x7b sequence=512
kernels: fused_gemm_16x64  62% tokens
         matmul_64x64_generic  28% tokens
KV cache mem: 1.8GB -> 2.43GB (+35%)
latency p50/p95/p99: 45/140/220ms -> 52/170/320ms
evictions: prefix-cache: 0.8% of requests trigger eviction, avg eviction cost 2.3ms
```
Also see repeated FP8->FP16 conversions in kv_path logs.

lina: Hypothesis: RoPE scaling change + different head_dim triggered a different kernel choice and smaller batch packing. Also FP8 cache path does a CPU-side dequant on eviction which adds latency. Quick experiment: override runtime to force fused kernel and bump batching thresholds.

lina: Config snippet to try:
```
runtime:
  kernels:
    force: fused_gemm
  batching:
    max_tokens_per_batch: 1024
    min_batch_tokens: 128
  kv:
    cache_precision: int8_compact  # opt-in
    eviction_policy: lru_with_prefetch
```

matthew: We should measure tradeoffs: int8_compact reduces memory but dequant cost may be on CPU now. Suggest run --profile-kv --tokens=1000000 for each path.

anna: Quick A/B results after forcing fused_gemm + int8_compact on canary:
```
before: p99=320ms, KV=2.43GB, CPU dequant spikes=3/min
after:  p99=260ms, KV=1.4GB (-42%), CPU dequant spikes=5/min (short)
notes: for seq<=1024 perf is stable; seq>2048 still has p99 tail due to eviction churn
```

jorge: If int8 dequant is CPU-bound, can kernel-team add a GPU dequant path for KV reads? Moving dequant to GPU would cut host CPU jitter and keep fused kernel benefits. @kernel-team

kernel-team: noted. We have a prototype for GPU int8-dequant but needs low-level kernels for kv layout; filing an RFC.

devops-bot: Canary deployed to mixtral-canary-3 (commit: a7f3d2). Monitoring p99 and host cpu.

lina: Also found a metadata bug: qwen models were tagged with head_dim=64 in catalog while actual is 128 -> wrong kernel match. PR incoming to add strict model->head/kv dims to the model-metadata table (PR #289).

matthew: Plan for tomorrow:
- patch kernel selector to consult model-metadata head/kv dims
- add runtime opt-in int8_compact for KV with observable dequant counter
- implement LRU_with_prefetch eviction for prefix-cache to avoid synchronous evictions
I'll run a canary and post numbers.

anna: Thanks. If everyone can add simple reproduce steps (seq, model, canary job id) in the PR comments that'd speed rollouts. :thumbsup:
